_meta.purpose: Extension of displacement_map.json for Config 2026 feature announcements. Same principle: search what the feature DISPLACES, not 'Figma'. Each entry adds a figma_surface value so posttype.py and the Haiku classifier can condition on it.
_meta.routing_note: Config-2026 signals skew EXPANSION, not net-new. Posters complaining about AE->Lottie handoff often already have Figma seats -> SFDC match will hit -> route UPSELL/AE, not SDR. Expect the P0-P3 distribution to shift vs the base map.
_meta.highest_intent_pattern: workflow_stitching -- a poster describing a multi-tool chain that one Config feature now collapses (e.g. 'Figma -> After Effects -> Lottie -> dev handoff'). Weight above single-tool mentions.

features.what_it_collapses: Design exploration happening OUTSIDE Figma in code sandboxes and AI app builders, plus the design<->code round-trip.
features.false_positive_traps: Founders using v0/Lovable/Bolt to SHIP apps (builder persona, not design workflow). Engineers with no designer in the loop. Keep the existing 'builder -> review only' title tier.

intent_examples.active_need: "Our prototypes drift from production because design and code live in different tools"
intent_examples.evaluating: "Testing whether v0 or Figma prototypes get better user-test signal"

features.what_it_collapses: The UI-motion pipeline: animate in AE, export via Lottie/Bodymovin, spec easing curves in screenshots, beg devs to match them.
features.false_positive_traps: AE is overwhelmingly film/social/VFX -- require a product-UI co-occurrence term or drop. Rive posts from game devs are off-ICP. Marketing-video Lottie use is weaker than product-UI Lottie use.

intent_examples.active_need: "Spent two days getting the dev build to match my AE easing curves"
intent_examples.evaluating: "Comparing Rive vs Lottie for our design system's motion tokens"
intent_examples.curious: "Anyone found a good way to make motion part of a design system?"

features.expansion_note: Motion-in-design-systems posts = strong expansion signal at existing Figma orgs (design systems imply org plan).

features.what_it_collapses: Hiring a creative developer (or fighting WebGL/GLSL) to get gradients, grain, noise, and hero-section effects.
or_queries: "how did they make" gradient OR grain effect
features.false_positive_traps: Game-dev shader content and pure generative artists. Require a web/product/brand context term. 'Hiring a creative developer' posts are ALSO a job-posting-intent style signal -- tag them.

intent_examples.active_need: "Need this grain/gradient effect for our rebrand but nobody on the team writes WebGL"
intent_examples.evaluating: "Trying Unicorn Studio for our new site's hero"
intent_examples.curious: "These shader-y landing pages are everywhere -- how are people making them?"

features.what_it_collapses: Custom Figma plugin development -- the API learning curve, the contractor, the weekend project, the internal tooling backlog.
or_queries: "is there a Figma plugin" OR "plugin that can"
features.false_positive_traps: Plugin AUTHORS marketing paid plugins (lead-magnet post_type already catches these -- they are competitors' engagers, not buyers). The buyers are in their comments.

intent_examples.active_need: "The plugin we depend on hasn't been updated in a year"
intent_examples.evaluating: "Scoping whether to build an internal plugin for our icon workflow"
intent_examples.curious: "What plugins is everyone using for X?"

features.expansion_note: Nearly all posters are EXISTING Figma users. This is a pure expansion/AI-tier signal -> route to AE. 'Is there a plugin that...' comments are the richest single-comment signal in this map: a stated need in the poster's own words.

features.what_it_collapses: Node-based generative pipelines stitched together outside design tools -- ComfyUI graphs, multi-model glue, prompt-and-pray asset production.
or_queries: ComfyUI workflow brand OR design OR marketing
Flora OR Krea OR "Visual Electric" workflow
features.false_positive_traps: Hobbyist AI artists and ML engineers dominate ComfyUI content. Require team/brand/marketing context. The ICP title filter (titles.py) does heavy lifting here -- expect a low pass rate and that is fine, tokens were never spent.

intent_examples.active_need: "Our ComfyUI setup only one person on the team can operate"
intent_examples.evaluating: "Testing Krea vs Flora for campaign asset generation"
intent_examples.curious: "How are creative teams actually operationalizing genAI?"

features.what_it_collapses: Manual glue between design and the rest of the stack: Figma<->Notion/Jira/Slack sync, design-system doc chores, status-update busywork.
or_queries: Figma Notion "out of sync" OR "keep in sync"
features.false_positive_traps: AI-tooling influencers posting about agents/MCP generically (the RPA-PM/growth-hacker crowd the base map already drops at titles.py). Require a design-workflow anchor.

intent_examples.active_need: "I spend Friday afternoons updating Notion to match what changed in Figma"
intent_examples.evaluating: "Trying to connect our design files to Slack updates automatically"
intent_examples.curious: "Are agents actually useful for design teams yet?"

features.expansion_note: Agent/connector posts from existing customers = AI-tier upsell. Also a CHURN counter-signal: teams building their own glue may be under-adopted on Figma's native features.

lead_magnet_playbook.principle: On a lead-magnet post, the POST classifies the commenter, not the comment. The comment is just a trigger word ('MOTION', 'GUIDE', a fire emoji) -- a thin hand-raise your richness lever already promotes when post_type = lead_magnet. So spend effort finding the right BAIT POSTS; the commenters classify themselves for free.

bait_detector_queries.note: Combine one bait phrase with one displaced-tool term. Bait phrases are tool-agnostic and reusable.

code_layers.why_commenter_qualifies: A designer requesting a learn-to-code-for-prototyping guide is the code-layers pitch verbatim: they want code as a design material without leaving their canvas.
code_layers.example_creator_niches: design-engineer influencers, v0/Lovable tutorial creators, 'designers who code' educators

bait_to_find: 'motion design crash course for product designers'
figma_motion.why_commenter_qualifies: Product designers requesting AE/Lottie resources are announcing they lack motion capability in their current stack -- exactly what Motion removes the need to leave Figma for.
figma_motion.example_creator_niches: UI-motion educators, LottieFiles ecosystem creators, Rive/Jitter template sellers

bait_to_find: 'how I built this hero effect -- comment for the breakdown'
ai_shaders.why_commenter_qualifies: Commenters are designers coveting effects they can't build without a creative developer. Shaders + agent = describe it, get it.
ai_shaders.example_creator_niches: creative developers showcasing hero sections, Unicorn Studio/Spline educators, award-site (Awwwards-style) breakdown creators

bait_to_find: 'how I built a plugin in a weekend'
generative_plugins.why_commenter_qualifies: Two harvests: guide-requesters (want tooling they can't build) AND 'does one exist that does X?' repliers -- the single richest comment type in this map, a need stated verbatim.
generative_plugins.example_creator_niches: plugin authors marketing free plugins, design-ops educators, Figma community creators

weave.why_commenter_qualifies: Requesting a workflow FILE means they want a reusable multi-model pipeline -- Weave's exact pitch. Filter hard on title tier here; this niche is hobbyist-heavy.
weave.example_creator_niches: ComfyUI workflow sharers with design/brand framing, AI-for-creatives educators

bait_to_find: 'Notion x Figma system -- comment for template'
figma_agent.why_commenter_qualifies: Requesting automation templates = drowning in glue work the agent's skills/connectors replace natively.
figma_agent.example_creator_niches: design-ops influencers, Notion-template creators in design niches, AI-workflow educators with design audiences

creator_watchlist_upgrade.idea: Serial magnet creators are renewable lead sources. After 2-3 runs, promote recurring authors into a watchlist (creators.json) polled every cron run BEFORE keyword search -- higher precision, lower Apify spend, and you catch every new post's commenters within 24h while the magnet is hot.
creator_watchlist_upgrade.flywheel: keyword search discovers creators -> watchlist monitors them -> run_log measures leads-per-creator -> prune creators whose commenters keep failing the ICP gate.

lead_magnet_playbook.trigger_word_handling: When post_type = lead_magnet, extract the post's trigger word ('WEBSITE', 'MOTION') in code and match comments against it deterministically. Trigger-word-only comments skip the Haiku call entirely: intent = active_need is given by the post, evidence_quote = the trigger word, verbatim by construction. Tokens: zero.

pipeline_changes.posttype_axis_addition: Add post_type values: displaced_tool_pain (complaint/friction), displaced_tool_showcase (demo of the displaced tool -- mine the COMMENTS, the poster is often a competitor-adjacent creator), workflow_stitching (multi-tool chain description -- highest intent, promote one confidence tier).
pipeline_changes.classifier_conditioning: Pass figma_surface + feature name into the Haiku call so 'suggested angle' references the specific Config 2026 feature, not generic Figma.
pipeline_changes.routing: Expect higher SFDC match rate than base map. Add rule: figma_surface in [GEN_PLUGINS, AGENT] + existing account -> UPSELL/AE by default.
pipeline_changes.monitoring: Track precision per figma_surface in run_log.jsonl -- MOTION and SHADERS will need stop-list tuning fastest (AE/game-dev noise). Golden set: add ~10 labeled posts per surface before enabling.
